window_id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier for the browser window during the current browser process.

tab_id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier for the tab during the current browser process.

target_id.description: CDP target ID for a custom tool's registration tab; omitted for page-provided tools.

page_title.description: Current title of the top-level page.

page_url.description: Current URL of the top-level page with the fragment omitted.

frame.description: Embedded frame that registered the tool, or null when the top-level page registered it.
